name: RA-D-3x
what: view D's base for the hatch-only step 2b: RA-D-1 with RA-D-3's desk and cabinet, completed in code, and the hatch's area left as RA-D-1's empty deck

codeComposite.how: RA-D-3's raw over RA-D-1 inside the step-2 mask limited to the desk's and the cabinet's areas and trimmed in front of the desk, feathered by a 2 px Gaussian (the image tool's keep, so equal to RA-D-3 there); inside each traced outline, the raw's pixels, with 1 px of feather outside it; nothing else from the raw

decision: the Lead, 27 November 2026, 21:03: both runs painted the hatch bigger and nearer and put the toolbox outside its area; make RA-D-3x, RA-D-1 with the desk and the cabinet each from whichever run has it better, completed from its raw where needed, the screens fitted and gated, the hatch's area left as RA-D-1's empty deck

why.cabinet: RA-D-3's frame ends 22 to 30 px below the mask, RA-D-3b's 46 to 56 px (a taller cabinet, with two boxes hanging below it); both run about 7 px past the mask on the right
why.desk: RA-D-3's desk runs past the mask only at the right monitor's right bezel (22 px) and the desk top's right corner (up to 14 px); RA-D-3b's also at the left monitor's top (about 15 px) and at the desk's right end (about 15 px)
why.both: both raws carry a sliver of the misplaced toolbox into the desk's area, on the deck in front of it: trimmed out

sources.name: RA-D-3
sources.what: the kept step 2 of the first run (its keep, rebuilt here and equal pixel for pixel)

sources.name: RA-D-3-raw
sources.what: RA-D-3's raw edit (the desk's and cabinet's areas, and inside the outlines)

mask.what: version 2's step-2 PLACE mask: its desk's and cabinet's areas taken, its hatch's area left out

trim.what: the deck in front of the desk where the misplaced toolbox's sliver reached into the desk's area: left as RA-D-1's deck
trim.sliverHow: the trimmed pixels where RA-D-3 differs from RA-D-1 by more than 40 levels; after the trim, RA-D-3x's largest difference from RA-D-1 on them

feather.how: alpha = 1 inside the outline, falling linearly to 0 at 1 px outside it, by each pixel centre's distance from the outline

tracing: on the raw: the cabinet's frame read across its ink every 4 px on each side, at the midpoint between the ink and the wall beside it, straight lines fitted (readings over 1.2 px off dropped once); the monitor's bezel and the desk's end read from the luminance at 5 to 6 times

pieces.name: the cabinet's frame, all round its outer ink
pieces.ink: the top edge (y = 690.40 - 0.0583 x), the right side (x = 995.51 + 0.0045 y), the bottom edge (y = 863.67 + 0.0633 x) and the left side (its outer lip at x 763.8 down to y 723, its ink at x 767.0 below), the corners cut 4 px across
pieces.note: the raw's frame runs about 7 px past the mask on the right, 22 to 30 px below it at the bottom and up to 4 px past it at the left lip; its top lies 5 px inside

pieces.name: the right monitor's right bezel
pieces.ink: the bezel's top ink (y 855.5), its top-right corner and its right side's outer ink (x 233.0); the screen and the rest of the monitor lie inside the mask
pieces.note: the raw's monitor reaches x 233, 22 px past the mask (x 211) from y 852 to 922

pieces.name: the desk top's right end, with its right leg's outer edge
pieces.ink: the desk top's top edge (y 966.6-972.2), its rounded corner and end (x 332.2), the leg's outer ink (x 328.0) down to its foot (y 1175)
pieces.note: the raw's desk top reaches x 332, up to 14 px past the mask (x 318) from y 966 to 996; the leg's ink lies 3 px inside the mask, where the keep's feather had faded it

ra-D-3x.png.what: the plate: RA-D-3x, a code composite of two AI-generated pictures
